Built for Comfort. Engineered to Work.

Compact Size. Big Capability.

The KIOTI CX2510HC is the perfect balance of performance, comfort, and versatility. Featuring a fully enclosed, factory-installed cab with heat and A/C, this compact utility tractor keeps you working comfortably year-round. Powered by a fuel-efficient 25 HP KIOTI diesel engine, the CX2510HC is ideal for everything from property maintenance to light commercial applications.

Whether you’re grading a driveway, clearing brush, or handling seasonal chores, this compact powerhouse is built to get the job done.

Features may include:

Reliable Diesel Power
The 24.5 HP KIOTI 3-cylinder diesel engine delivers dependable torque and fuel efficiency.

Deluxe Cab with Climate Control
Stay productive in any weather with a premium, fully sealed cab featuring heat, air conditioning, and wide visibility.

Power Steering
Standard power steering and a single-hand joystick control make operation smooth and easy.

Hydrostatic Transmission (HST)
3-range HST provides seamless speed control and direction changes for loader work and mowing.

Category I 3-Point Hitch
Lift capacity of 1,203 lbs at hitch point—perfect for implements like box blades, tillers, and more.

Independent PTO
Rear PTO with auto/manual selection offers easy control of powered attachments like mowers or augers.

Comfort & Accessibility
Tilt steering, deluxe suspension seat, ergonomic controls, and wide operator platform ensure a fatigue-free ride.
